node.title: E22 minimal-scale overlap count formulas
node.statement: For each dyadic pair of scales M_i<M_j, compute exactly the number of support classes whose minimal admissible scale is M_i and which are also counted by the raw quotient staircase summand at M_j. This is reduced to the proved nested-fiber residual identity and the remaining exact residual-profile formula, including all declared duplicate or multiplicity factors used by dyadic_profile_evaluation.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the nested-fiber residual identity and the remaining exact residual-profile formulas
node.falsifier: a smaller-minimal-scale class contributing to a larger raw scale with an unaccounted or wrongly weighted overlap
